dropTheme.note: Which half of the wild drop table is favoured (TRANSFER-MAP §1.4 — the loot flip). INTEGRATION GAP (flagged at P0 landing): src/data/core/wild-drop-tables.json exists in the repo but has NO consumer in src today, so there is no drop path to read this yet. src/lib/honor.ts exposes favouredDropHalf(bandId) as the integration point; wiring it into drops waits for a drop consumer to exist.

greetingRegister.note: Greeting warmth tier per band (#93 faces / #242 crowd texture read this; TRANSFER-MAP §1.4). Reads VISIBLE SIGNS only — a group with no witnessed facts of its own reads this register off the morale band provisionally (first impressions, #270). Tier words are DRAFT presentation data.

lawTemperament.note: Mitigation/aggravation WEIGHT when the law judges (#230 discipline / #272 wanted read this; TRANSFER-MAP §1.4) — a weight, never a pardon. Draft values: good bands mitigate in proportion to band depth (band index 1..5 → 0.2..1.0), bad bands aggravate likewise, Unmarked is neutral.

note: Band response tables for the honor system (List 28 #269/#271 + honor-west TRANSFER-MAP §1.4), landed by the honor wiring P0 (2026-10-29). Honor is invisible except through these tables; each is keyed by band and each pays BOTH directions in different currencies (the two-sided pay law — a table that only punishes the bad side fails review). Band NAMES are DRAFT data (owner slot §5.1 — renaming is a data edit, never a code change). Effect VALUES are drafted system data from the List 28 spectrum fragment (1%/step shop draft), tunable at landing.

postingGate.note: Which work postings show, by band (#164; spectrum fragment: service work at Decent+, underworld work at Shady- in the underworld's own swapped reading).

fence.note: Fences mirror honest shops on the BAD side only (spectrum fragment draft): payout improves 1% per bad step, capped by band.

honest.note: Honest-shop adjustment accrues 1% per step (List 28 spectrum fragment DRAFT), capped by band ceiling: good side discounts, bad side surcharges. Cap values are draft data (= the band's top step magnitude).

shopTerms.note: applyBandPrice in src/lib/honor.ts is the only arithmetic consumer: price = base adjusted by clamp(|steps| * perStepPct, cap) with the sign of the band's side (fence: adjustment applies to payout on the bad side only; an honest price is never improved by a bad band at a fence, and never worsened by a good one).

wantedHeat.note: DRAFT thresholds mapping deriveWantedHeat's number to #272's five wanted levels (draft words from the wanted fragment). Heat = sum of |values| of witnessed BAD deeds in the area inside the window. Wanted DECAYS on a schedule (#272: per-level data rates, faster outside the region, cleared early by answering) — decay rates are a P2 data addition; P0's heat read is window-based only, and the law reads only the witnessed subset of the ledger, ever.
